name: Methyldienolone (Methyldienolone / M-Dien)

lead: Methyldienolone (RU-3467) is an oral 17-alpha-methylated 19-nortestosterone derivative that appears in bodybuilding discussion as a muscle-building compound. It was never marketed as a drug.

It is classed as an androgen receptor agonist, which is the proposed route to anabolic muscle effects. The literature consists of chemistry and doping-control papers, and no pharmacokinetic detail or human data were found.

paras: It has no marketed form; it is discussed in bodybuilding communities as an oral compound.
No adverse-effect data were found. It is prohibited in sport and listed as a US Schedule III substance per Wikipedia.

angle.text: Bodybuilding discussion treats it as an oral androgen that activates the androgen receptor for more muscle mass. Almost nothing is published beyond detection chemistry, and its muscle effect in people has not been studied.

lead: Methyldienolone (RU-3467) is a synthetic, orally active anabolic-androgenic steroid, a 17-alpha-methylated 19-nortestosterone derivative.[1] It has not been marketed as a medicine. Published literature is sparse.
Wikipedia lists it as a US Schedule III substance and as prohibited by the World Anti-Doping Agency.[1]

paras: No studies found. Related laboratory work includes an environmental chemistry study of photolysis products of methyldienolone and dienogest, which found products with progestogenic and androgenic activity weaker than the parents,[2] and a 2026 study identifying metabolites with human liver microsomes for doping control.[3]
